messages:
maria: Quick FYI — Node SDK (v2.0.0) is serializing boolean query params as 1/0 (integers) when calling admin endpoints. private deploys with strict JSON schema reject it. hitting validation error on onboarding sample app.
lee: oof. show a tiny repro? which call in the sample app?
maria: onboarding checks: /admin/validate_flag?enabled=1 returns 400 from our strict validator. curl with enabled=false works.
```
// via sdk
client.admin.validateFlag({ name: 'new_feature', enabled: 1 })
// server
{ "error": "invalid param enabled: expected boolean" }
```
qa: wondering if this is related to recent query-normalization change that attempted to coerce truthy values. we have unit tests for strings/booleans but maybe only covered Python SDK.
lee: version bump to v2.0.0 shipped yesterday. I can repro locally against a strict private stack. assign to me. looks like QuerySerializer.coerceBooleans -> Number(...) somewhere.
maria: this blocks a few P0 private onboardings this week (they use strict schema). can we get a patch release?
devops-bot: ticket RDW-4401 created: node-sdk-query-bool-serial-regression. CI: added failing e2e in matrix (private-strict). https://go/redwood/rdw-4401
lee: plan: revert the numeric coercion and add explicit boolean path: true/false as bare tokens for query params if schema type == boolean. add e2e test in the private matrix and a unit for query serializer. will open PR for 2.0.1.
qa: please also add a smoketest that runs the onboarding sample app against hosted and private strict stacks in CI (matrix entry). caught that too late.
maria: thanks — tagging @devex to update onboarding docs to mention SDK min version until patch is out.
lee: will post PR link and changelog when ready. quick temporary workaround for affected customers: call REST endpoint directly or set enabled: false (boolean) in the body when available.
maria: appreciate the quick response. small but nasty DX regression. :disappointed:
